issues.description: At 2200ms seated-right, Karo's shorts read as one compressed ragged band across the lap: the two leg openings and their separating contour are not clearly distinguishable. Both 1240ms transitions retain a crotch notch, and the 4800ms standing pose clearly restores two tubes, so the standing endpoint does not resolve the seated silhouette issue.
issues.repair: Adjust the seated mesh and internal crotch/hem contours so two distinct shorts tubes remain readable around the respective thighs. Preserve the opaque outer boundary and closed waist/hip coverage; verify both 1240ms directions and the 2200ms hold after adjustment.

warnings: All four screenshots were inspected. No clear translucent exterior hem, doubled exterior silhouette, open outline, or exposed mesh crack is visible at this resolution. Lila retains a single ragged dress; no clear detached hand or neck attachment is visible.
Side/rear torso artwork and independent garment-panel swing in seated plans remain unproved.
These static poses do not establish continuous-motion smoothness, video quality, background integration, or acceptance of the final episode and all three input flows.
The inferred knee placement near 52/48, preservation of total source leg lengths, and seat contact below/behind the belt do not establish anatomical or fabric-simulation guarantees.
